title: Plasma cutter on its gantry
label: Tall CNC plasma table on long legs with a lower shelf: a water tray of thick slats and back compartments under a steel plate, a gantry of narrow uprights and a racked beam with a looping drag chain, and a slim torch cutting a hexagon.
caption: The gantry rides the side rails and the carriage runs along the racked beam, so the torch can trace any path; the arc leaves a black kerf while sparks drop through the slats and light the one beneath the cut. Move across the figure to run the cut.
